title: Kimi K3 is associated with Kimi Code
summary: On 2026-07-16, the Kimi K3 development line referenced Kimi Code through the dated Kimi link. This indicates a code-oriented Kimi K3-related development step, although the available evidence does not establish the specific capability, release status, or scope. The proposed history event should remain subject to human confirmation.
